name: ulta-uc1-wfb
description: Ulta Beauty batch creative production workflow automation UI. Upload CSV + PSD templates, trigger a Workflow Builder batch execution, show status.

auth.notes: Internal tool with no login screen by design (out of v1 scope). Actions are unauthenticated at the platform level — anyone with the action URL can invoke them. AWS/Workflow Builder credentials still never leave the backend. Revisit with IMS PKCE SPA login if this needs to be locked down to specific users.

storage.primary: External S3 presign-proxy service (S3_PRESIGN_URL), credentials held in action env only
notes: presign-upload calls the proxy server-side with S3_ACCESS_KEY/S3_SECRET_KEY from .env to get putUrl/getUrl.
Browser PUTs bytes directly to putUrl and Workflow Builder reads from getUrl — action code never sees file bytes, browser never sees AWS credentials.

workflow.note: Bearer token and API key are configured server-side only. Never sent to or stored in the frontend.
